usage.finalMessage:
I added the `next-free <clinician> <time>` command and listed it in `help` directly after `schedule`; it's committed and `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` passes (7 of 7, including two new tests).
`next-free` only looks up to 60 days ahead, the limit in the current horizon rule (DEC-C05), but `book` still allows bookings up to 90 days under the replaced rule (DEC-C01). I left `book` alone because the work item says existing behaviour must not change.
That mismatch is the open question in `.work/report.json`: should someone raise a separate item to move `book` to 60 days?
